comment: Decisions of the AI integrator for the AR v3 beta, prepared under the owner's delegation R-146ba (accepted risks A-10 and A-11): no subject-matter expert took part, no human compared any norm with its official edition, and nothing here asserts that an edition is current or that a branch applies to a real project. Project date: not set; the beta runs on synthetic documents (R-146bb). Modes: the 8 items C05 C06 C08 C09 C10 C15 C21 C22 are context_only by the beta policy and stay so; the other 14 are provisional_citation with empty edition_evidence (no official page was fetched or compared). Mapping of include/revise/exclude to the tool, which has no exclude state: include = provisional_citation on the proposed span; exclude = context_only, which STILL renders the target text into the prompt part and does NOT remove it from the model's context. Spans: those of spans.proposal.json with the paragraph ids of AR-V3-BETA-SPANS-MEASURE-01; C13 and C20 repeat the spans of C12 and C19; C22 takes D5 ordinals 289-300 (a judgement, see AR-V3-ACTIVATION-PREP-01). Query vectors: query_vectors.sha256_by_scope holds, per scope, the SHA-256 of the lines '<item_id> <vector_sha256>' of the scope's items (rule in docs/program/ar-v3-beta/README.md) computed from the vectors made on 2026-10-27 in the hash-checked bge-m3-dense-v1 environment; the provenance record is docs/program/ar-v3-beta/vectors-provenance.json. There is no review block: the pack summary stays pending_expert.
